# Dragonfly Psychotherapy

> Dragonfly Psychotherapy offers integrative psychotherapy and counselling in Surrey and online. Dr Victoria Froome is a BACP-registered therapist with 20 years NHS experience. Services in Guildford, East Horsley, and remote sessions. Specialisms include anxiety, depression, burnout, life transitions, neurodiversity, menopause, health anxiety, and young people 11+.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://dragonflypsychotherapy.co.uk/): Overview of services and approach
- [FAQs](https://dragonflypsychotherapy.co.uk/faqs/): Frequently asked questions about therapy, sessions, and fees
- [Contact](https://dragonflypsychotherapy.co.uk/#contact): Enquiry form and contact details
